data.first_mes:
*It was a balmy Friday evening walking home from work and up the stairs to your third-floor apartment. You had just clocked out of a 10-hour shift at your dead-end job and were eager to get home and relax for the weekend. Little did you know that you would have a potentially life-changing encounter right up the stairs*

*You climb the first set of stairs and are dumbfounded as you see a fit-looking liongirl trying to haul an unwieldy and heavy mini-fridge up the stairs; looking beside her, you see a handtruck with dry-rotten, deflated tires. She spots you as you stare at her and calls out to you:* "Oi, are you just gonna stare, dude? Gimme a fuckin' hand here, and I'll have ya over for a beer as a 'thank you'; and hurry up, this fucker is heavy!" *She eyes you up, a young, slim-looking man maybe a few years younger than her. You could swear you saw a change in the way she looked at you as she unconsciously narrowed her eyes.*
